title: Completed reduction respects the strict inverse-image square
statement: For an adic coefficient datum d and chosen cartesian scheme square sq [def-weil-pbc-four-corners], the four normalized completed reduction/pullback comparisons [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] commute with the integral ambient inverse-image square and the exact termwise integral tower square [def-weil-pbc-strict-tower-operations]. This is equality of natural transformations to the derived category of strict towers, before taking any mates or evaluations. No properness, completeness, or etale-origin witness is assumed.

proof.text: Choose a flat-term K-flat representative P on Y. The two successive inverse images remain flat-term K-flat. At each quotient level tensor balancing and compatibility of the projections prove equality of the ordinary strict tower-complex maps; the equality retains all quotient transitions.

Use the normalization equations fixing completedReductionPullbackIso on all four edges. Localize the ordinary compositor and cancel the invertible K-flat comparison counits to obtain the square on Q(P). Resolve an arbitrary object and apply naturality; no faithfulness of derived evaluations is used.

lean.statement:
theorem completedReductionPullback_square
    (sq : ChosenCartesianSquare g' f' f g) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (d.reductionTowerPullbackIso g).hom (d.towerPull f') ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (d.pull g) (d.reductionTowerPullbackIso f').hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight
        (proEtaleAmbientRingedPullbackComparison sq
          (d.completedRing X) (d.completedRing Y) (d.completedRing X') (d.completedRing Y')
          (d.integralRingIso f) (d.integralRingIso g) (d.integralRingIso g')
          (d.integralRingIso f') (d.integral_coherent sq)).hom
        (completedReductionTower X' d) =
    Functor.whiskerLeft (completedReductionTower Y d)
        (d.integralTowerRingedSquare sq).exchangeTowerSquare.hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (d.reductionTowerPullbackIso f).hom (d.towerPull g') ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (d.pull f) (d.reductionTowerPullbackIso g').hom
